evals.name: adv-issue
evals.prompt: A buyer on Facebook Marketplace paid me $200 via a payment app, then filed a chargeback claiming the item never arrived after picking it up in person. I'm in New York. Using Nolo's method, frame the issue and lay out the research path.
assertions: Frames the issue: civil vs criminal, substantive vs procedural, area of law
Uses the Cartwheel method or keyword brainstorming
Points to secondary sources first (e.g. practice guides, Am. Jur., form books) then primary law
Mentions checking that law is still good (Shepardize/KeyCite or updates/pocket parts)
Mentions small claims court and/or when to hire a lawyer; notes it's not legal advice

evals.name: adv-memo
evals.prompt: Explain how to read a statute and a case for my small-claims dispute, then outline an IRAC memo.
assertions: Gives rules for reading statutes (e.g. read definitions, every word matters, cross-references)
Explains holding vs dicta in cases
Outlines IRAC: Issue, Rule, Analysis/Application, Conclusion
Includes citation practice or verifying currency of the law
